items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Now there's the period with Winonie Harris. ... you continued regular arranging, including for and playing with Swingers, Inc. ... What do you remember from that period after you were finished with Winonie?

ctx.x: Because when he played on the road, Winonie (inaudible) had to let him go because when he play, everybody come all up on the stage and get around him.
Well, he sang on all of them, did he?
